season.evidence: Stored Jul-Oct, best mid-Jul to Sep. Ascents: May 11, Jun 9, Jul 20, Aug 16, Sep 9, Oct 5. Web search: SummitPost says climbable any season but late spring/early summer best, melting snow for water in spring; Mountaineers lists the Dungeness traverse. Stored window kept.

otherTracksConsidered.why: May 21 2026 complete round trip via Home Lake/Constance Pass matching our line, but May is two months before the window and snow-covered.
Oct 28 2023 complete round trip but via the Royal Basin side and the north-east ridge, not the Home Lake/Constance Pass approach this row describes.
Jul 17 2024 partial recording starting in Deception Basin, 9.5 km from trailhead pin.

facts.text: Late September: on the way down the summit ridge, stay on the north side; a lower path there skips the towers and is far less exposed.
From Deception Basin, the saddle between Hal Foss and Fricaba gives a plain class 2 scree slog, far easier than the glacier-side gully (September).

notes: Only the May track follows the described Home Lake line and it is off-season. Oct 28 2023 track (2441948) uses a Royal Basin-side approach; add as an alternate approach later if the owner wants it.
